question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "built."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this sentence, the correct form of the verb** "build"** to use is **"built."**
 
• The past participle** "built"** is used here to indicate that the Floating Post Office was constructed in the past and is now in existence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct paragraph: 

Tourists Travelling to__ Jammu and Kashmir have another attraction – a floating post office on the Dal Lake in Srinagar, the first in the country. Floating Post Office, Dal Lake – claimed to be the only one such post office in the world – is __**built**__ on an intricately carved maroon houseboat, fastened on the western edge of the Dal Lake
